h1: AnnaLena wins Vancouver’s first two Michelin stars
title: AnnaLena Wins Vancouver’s First Two Michelin Stars
description: AnnaLena became Vancouver’s first two-Michelin-star restaurant on 6 October 2026, and Barbara lost its star. What a meal at AnnaLena costs.
summary: AnnaLena in Kitsilano becomes the city’s first two-star restaurant; Barbara loses its star, and no restaurant wins a first.
imageAlt: Linocut-style print of coastal mountains and evergreen forest above an inlet, a plate of seafood in front and two gold stars between the peaks.
body:
AnnaLena in Kitsilano became Vancouver’s first two-MICHELIN-star restaurant at the city’s ceremony at the Fairmont Hotel Vancouver on 6 October 2026. Barbara lost its star and no restaurant won a first, so Vancouver now has 11 starred restaurants: AnnaLena and ten with one star.

What a meal at AnnaLena costs

Chef Michael Robbins’ AnnaLena has held one star since 2022. Its tasting menu costs {{dinner:annalena}} per person before tax and tip, and the wine pairing {{wine:annalena}}. It is now one of three two-star restaurants in Canada.

Which Vancouver restaurant lost its star?

Barbara, Patrick Hennessy’s restaurant, stays in the guide as a Recommended restaurant without its star. The ten one-stars all kept theirs, from Kissa Tanto to Okeya Kyujiro and Published on Main.

The rest of the guide

The fifth Vancouver guide lists 72 restaurants, with 16 Bib Gourmands; Chef’s Choice Seafood and Kavita are the new ones. Every starred restaurant in the city, with prices, is on our Vancouver Michelin star restaurants page, and every change is on our MICHELIN Guide Vancouver 2026 results page.
